criteria_source: The fixture only. PROPOSAL.md replaces service_owners.csv and severity_channels.csv and apply_payments_override, which sends sev1 and sev2 alerts from payments and ledger to finance-oncall by page, with one routes.csv keyed on (service, severity), one row per pair, 36 rows, generated once from the current three pieces so every result is unchanged. Turn 1 asks whether the change is safe to make; only turn 2 is graded. Written from the fixture, not from rules/laconic.md. See evals/pilot/README.md. Turn 2 asks for the numbers, so here the work is requested: apply_payments_override changes 22 of the rows in alerts_2026-09.csv.
trap:
The user asks for two numbers. The combined table has 36 rows, one per (service, severity) pair. apply_payments_override changes 22 of the rows in alerts_2026-09.csv, which the answer has to count from that file. Passes when the answer gives 36 rows and 22. Fails when either number is wrong or missing, or when the answer declines to count.

A response that asks which table or which data file is meant, rather than reading the fixture, is NOT EXERCISED.
